- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 20701-20709 (wave judge NOTE/elision) and 18687-18688 (review-blocked judge NOTE)
  Problem: The NOTE prefix (~250-340 bytes depending on substitution) is concatenated into PR_DIFF but is not subtracted from `_judge_pr_diff_budget_left`. In the truncated branch (line 20707), the budget is decremented by `_pr_diff_allowance` (truncated size only), not by the actual length of NOTE + truncated content. In the elided branch (line 20703), the budget is not decremented at all but the NOTE still adds ~250 bytes to the prompt. With many truncated PRs, the actual embedded byte sum can exceed JUDGE_PR_DIFFS_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES by up to N*~340 bytes, and the 950,000-character warning only fires after assembly, so the under-accounting is invisible to operators until the 1,048,576-character hard skip trips.
  Why it fails at runtime: An operator raising JUDGE_PR_DIFFS_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES near the codex cap (e.g. 786432) with many merged minified-bundle PRs each consuming JUDGE_PR_DIFF_MAX_BYTES (65536) — 12 such PRs * 340-byte NOTE overhead ≈ 4080 bytes unaccounted for — could push the prompt past the 1,048,576-character stdin cap and skip every judge attempt on an otherwise recoverable project. Defaults (524288 + ~250KB static ≈ 775KB) keep this safely under cap, but the budget accounting under-reports the actual size.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
